name: agentic-plugins
description: Cross-host AI agent collaboration framework — Claude Code & Codex CLI

plugins.name: attention
plugins.description: Attention sensors — hook-only L1 plugin whose Claude lifecycle-hook sensors feed allowlisted runtime-owned executors (ADR-0040 §3, amended by ADR-0044 §2 and ADR-0045 §2): operator notifications (approval prompts, idle prompts, turn/workflow terminals, subagent completion) into the runtime notification emitter, the Stop-ordered session-capture spawn into context.mjs publish-session, and the SessionStart entry-brief spawn into context.mjs entry-brief (explicit startup matcher + explicit timeout, relaying at most one validated marker-paired line into context — the scoped ADR-0045 §2.2 stdout exception; every notify-pipeline sensor stays stdout-silent). Triple capability floors that never share a constant: notify >= 0.71.0 (code-pinned), publish-session >= 0.82.0 and entry-brief >= 0.83.0 (both declared in data/runtime-floors.json). Notifications stay inert until the operator opts into a notify_channel, session capture until session_capture is opted in (evaluated publisher-side), and the entry line until the user-scope-only entry_brief key is set (evaluated arbiter-side) — each gate independent, all via runtime:settings. Zero plugin-owned Codex hook surface: no Codex manifest hooks key and no root default hooks file — the Claude registration is manifest-scoped at adapters/claude/hooks/hooks.json, outside Codex default-file discovery (ADR-0040 §3 amendment); Codex-side attention is the runtime notification-plan fragments (§4), and the capture + entry firing points are Claude-only at v1 (ADR-0044 §8 / ADR-0045 §10 — Codex gets the CLI + dashboard surfaces).

plugins.name: companions
plugins.description: First-party Claude/Codex companion bridges and companion discovery library per companions/contract.md v0.1.1

plugins.name: designer
plugins.description: Designer workbench for code-first design/UX decision & quality assurance across Claude Code & Codex CLI (ADR-0042). The third L3 persona after engineer and founder — the six cognitive verbs re-anchored to UX/UI/CTA/flow, with pre-code design thinking (flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, IA) and a post-code quality-critique loop over rendered screenshots + frontend code, accessibility the veto gate. All six verbs, the designer:start lifecycle macro, and the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills ship (ADR-0042 Accepted). Composes the image L2 capability rather than re-implementing imagery; Figma excluded in v1.

plugins.name: engineer
plugins.description: Engineer workbench for AI-assisted engineering across Claude Code & Codex CLI — 6 cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine), /engineer:start lifecycle macro, 3 workflow-continuity meta skills (resume / checkpoint / peer-now), and cited-brief research profile.

plugins.name: founder
plugins.description: Founder workbench for AI-assisted new-business planning across Claude Code & Codex CLI — business-item discovery, ideation, concretization, and planning composition through the six cognitive verbs (ADR-0036). The second L3 persona after engineer: workflow machinery, hooks, all six verb surfaces (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine), the business ensemble protocol, the founder:start lifecycle macro, and the resume / checkpoint / peer-now meta skills — all shipped (ADR-0036 Accepted).

plugins.name: image
plugins.description: Image capability — cross-host image generation via Codex's integrated gpt-image tool through the companion bridge. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0037). Six cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine); generation runs only through Codex's integrated gpt-image (never a direct OpenAI API call), with the Claude host dispatching through the codex-companion bridge.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Macro orchestration capability — multi-deliverable plan + Plan-verify ensemble + same-host dispatch into engineer, lifecycle closure, and workflow-continuity meta surfaces for AI-assisted development across Claude Code & Codex CLI. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0018 §sub-decision-1, ADR-0019 cross-plugin invocation).

plugins.name: runtime
plugins.description: Runtime operator control plane for agentic-plugins host readiness, doctor diagnostics, settings planning, machine bootstrap lifecycle (ADR-0046), workflow storage migration, consensus artifacts, compatibility drift planning, worktree planning, context hygiene artifacts, model/effort config, companion readiness, and workflow ledger health. L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024.
